title: システムモデリング
subtitle: Systems Modeling
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) how to grasp complex systems correctly. (2) how to describe conceptual models using UML diagrams. (3) how to improve the system using the model.
advice: To grasp complex systems correctly, the following three abilities are required : 1. The ability to view the system in two levels (concept level and implementation level). 2. The ability to view the system from three aspects (static, functional, and dynamic). 3. The ability to visualize the structure and behavior of the system with appropriate expressions. In the first half of the class, students will learn 1 and 2 through lectures and quizzes, and in the second half, they will learn 3 through exercises. In 3, students use PC to draw UML diagrams. As the drawing software, astah* will be used. The installing will be instructed in the class.
books: Textbook : The Introduction to UML Modeling, Nikkei-BP (Japanese book)
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of any model diagram (Not required)

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain "three facets" and associate UML diagrams.
Be able to draw UML diagrams of a simple system.
Be able to design specific requirements and draw the concept model.
Be able to understand system behavior from UML diagrams.
Be able to pick up problems and improve systems.
